content:
Laredo's race for mayor is headed to a December runoff after no candidate won more than 50 percent of the vote on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, according to KGNS.

District 8 Councilwoman Alyssa Cigarroa led the field with 35.10 percent, and incumbent Mayor Dr. Victor Treviño finished second with 32.5 percent, according to KGNS. The two will face off in the December runoff, with just over a month to campaign.

The race drew a five-candidate field that also included JD Gonzalez, Poncho Casso and Jorge A. Garza, according to KGNS, which did not report percentages for those candidates.

Turnout was heavy across Webb County, with 60,127 ballots cast on Election Day, according to KGNS, and runoff voting still ahead. The Laredo Morning Times also confirmed the runoff matchup.

Sources:

  • KGNS — Laredo mayoral race heads to December runoff
  • Laredo Morning Times — Cigarroa, Treviño advance to runoff in Laredo mayoral race
